credits.title: KUBANA
credits.overview: In a poetic vision where art and memory intertwine, KUBANA combines various stories of the Tutsi genocide in Rwanda to explore how to rebuild society after the unspeakable.

credits.title: Black Tea
credits.overview: Aya, a young Ivorian woman in her early thirties, says no on her wedding day, to everyone’s astonishment. After emigrating to Asia, she works in a tea export shop with Cai, a 45-year-old Chinese man. Aya and Cai fall in love but can their affair survive the turmoil of their past and other people’s prejudices?

credits.title: Small Country: An African Childhood
credits.overview: Gabriel, aged 10, lives in a comfortable ex-pat neighborhood in Burundi, his ‘small country’. Gabriel is a normal kid, happy, carefree and having adventures with his friends and little sister. Then in 1993, tensions in neighboring Rwanda spill over, threatening his family and his innocence.
